title: Smart Contract based On-chain Random Number Generation (RNG) Library

ms.promise:
・Design and documentation for a Verifiable Onchain RNG Algorithm compatible with python, javascript and typescript.
・Architectural designs for smart contracts for Onchain RNG and Oracle RNG Data Feed.
ms.criteria:
・Completion of RNG algorithm design and smart contract architecture, documented and compatible with current standards.
・Successful setup of project infrastructure. (Github Repository)
